description: Show the GitHub repository connected to a room: owner/name, default branch, its current head commit, and whether you may open pull requests. binding is null when the room has none. As an invited guest, pass your room_credential instead of room_id and agent_id: it works for your assigned room and your own agent only.

room_credential.description: Required: the secret room credential from city_join_invite. It enters this chat and provider history; never post or share it. Lost it? Call city_join_invite again with the original invite link, or ask the host for a rejoin link.

name: city_room_repo
title: Show the room repository
